QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Cracking the Code
QuestInfo.0: Hirrel says he was looking for you. What does he need?
QuestInfo.1: The spellbooks you brought Hirrel are enchanted to be unreadable. They must contain important secrets. See if #bBeatrice#k can break the spell.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Beatrice. Hopefully she can break the spell.

0.0: It's the spellbooks you brought me. I can't read them at all!#k\r\n#L0##b...I told you so.#l\n#k
0.1: You misunderstand. I thought the books were in code, but it turns out they're enchanted.\r\n#L0##bEnchanted how?#l\n#k
0.2: The spell jumbles up all the words. Do you know how hard it is to file books properly when they're all in gibberish? If they went through these lengths to hide the contents of these books, then imagine what secrets they must contain!\r\n#L0##bThey might explain what the Black Mage is after!#l\n#k
0.3: Such a discovery would be vital to the updated history of Kritias I'm working on... \r\nCould you take this book to #bBeatrice#k at the academy?

yes.0: I'd have broken the spell on this book myself if I could, but we're going to need #bBeatrice's#k help to make sense of it all.

no.0: Hmph. I'm filing your response in my 'unhelpful' folder.

1.0: #h0#! I've just finished roto-synchronizing those metal samples you brought me. As I was about to tell General Blundell...

yes.0: I see you have something new for me.

npc.0: Beatrice will be around the Ranheim Academy.
